title: Boeing Tears Open 30 777Xs, American Flirts With The A330neo Right As Its Engine Gets Flagged, and a Drone Shuts Down San Diego
summary: Boeing's 777X problem gets weirder — finished jets now have to be partially disassembled before they can ever fly a passenger. American Airlines is circling the exact same plane whose engine just got an FAA safety order. Plus, a drone and a weather balloon shut down San Diego for hours, and we cover a genuinely tragic ramp accident in Montreal.
